title: BoHo Hip and chic.. looks like the 70’s has returned!!
text:
BoHo Hip and chic.. looks like the 70’s has returned!!. Very shabby chic and BoHo trendy which seems to be all the rage these days!! Although exterior of design measures 15-17”… Take note, the mirror itself is only half the size- approx. only 8-9”. This should be used for decor but, not as a daily functioning mirror.. it’s far too small and also, not crystal clear. You must be gentle with surface of mirror when cleaning as this face can scratch easy with pressure, compromising a mirrored reflection.

The macramé design visually resembles that in website description.. but, in person it has more frays and loose ends. Personally, I relate this to a vintage look.. almost if it’s been around since the 70’s! The overall knot tying is just not as crisp, tight as it appears in photo. Not a dealbreaker but something to mention.

Item is lightweight and easy enough to hang… Simply thread nail through braided edge and this will hold without issue. This can play a fun role when used in a wall collagé- or, stand alone on its own. For size/quality of physical mirror, I find this a higher price point at $25.. and figure your paying for the trend. Hoping this info can help and your decision.. stay safe!
